description:
Browse priced HTTP 402 capabilities, USD rates, and input schemas. Use this first to find capability_id values; do not use for dry-runs (x402_preview_capability), ledger probes (x402_check_health), or multi-item pricing (x402_quote_plan).
Parameters: omit filters for a compact ~5KB index (94% fewer tokens), pass lane to scope, or pass capability_id / include_schemas=true for full JSON schemas.
Behavior: no auth, zero charge; returns one unpaginated compact index (~30 capabilities, 6 lanes), cached 30s.

capability_id.description: Optional specific capability_id or route key to inspect (e.g. "reality_harbor_state", "audio_visual_isolate", or "POST /switchboard/chunk") with its full input_schema and example_arguments.

include_schemas.description: Optional boolean; omit or false (default) for a compact ~5KB index, or pass true to embed full JSON input_schema and example_arguments for every returned capability.

lane.description: Optional capability lane filter: live_data (maritime/harbor/parking oracles), studio_audio (GPU stem separation), switchboard (11-language voice/broadcast), member_tools (KB/co-creation), live_broadcast, destination_hubs (Global Food & Hyperlocal Compliance Hubs), or reality_clearing (Proof-of-Reality Clearinghouse & Optical Corroboration).

name: x402_list_capabilities

capabilities.description: Flat list of priced HTTP 402 capabilities including exact input_schema and example_arguments.

lanes.description: Grouped capability lanes with pricing cards.

ok.description: True when the capability catalog loaded successfully.

zero_crypto_required.description: True indicating Stripe USD prepaid settlement with zero crypto wallet required.

title: List X402 Capabilities
